findings.summary: ActionPlan.model_validate(existing_plan) reruns graph checks but skips PlannedStep validation. After mutating the still-mutable proposal.arguments to contain a literal $lineage or a LineageRef naming a missing dependency, validation succeeds. An equivalent freshly constructed plan rejects it. Revalidate step-local invariants when validating existing or model_construct-created plans, and add regression tests.
findings.evidence: src/e_agent/contracts/plan.py:100; src/e_agent/contracts/plan.py:79; ADR 0025 validation requirements; target architecture 6.4.3-6.4.4

findings.summary: LineageRef accepts a newline-only path, including through JSON validation. The regex uses match() with $, which can match before a final newline, so this invalid nonempty pointer passes as an empty match. Use fullmatch() and test rejection of a newline-only path while preserving valid pointers containing newlines after '/'.
findings.evidence: src/e_agent/contracts/plan.py:51; src/e_agent/contracts/plan.py:23; target architecture 6.4.3 requires an RFC 6901 JSON pointer
